title: Virtual Campus Tour — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

paras: Scroll to wander through our premises in Jhapa — from the entrance to the labs, library, and grounds.

blocks.heading: Main Entrance
paras: Step through the gates of WCBT in Jhapa, where your journey into technology and innovation begins.

blocks.heading: Academic Block
paras: Modern classrooms and smart lecture halls designed for collaborative, hands-on learning.

blocks.heading: Library & Resources
paras: A quiet space for research and study, with digital and print resources at your fingertips.

blocks.heading: Computer & Innovation Labs
paras: Well-equipped spaces for coding, electronics, robotics, and project work — the heart of practical learning.

blocks.heading: Student Lounge
paras: Relaxed spaces to collaborate, recharge, and connect with fellow students between classes.

blocks.heading: Campus Grounds
paras: Open spaces for sports, events, and the vibrant community life that makes WCBT feel like home.

blocks.heading: Seen enough? Come see it in person.
paras: Photos only go so far. Book a campus visit or talk to our admissions team.
